messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in the open plaza, raises one arm to touch or adjust the head, then lowers the arm and turns slightly while placing a hand on the hip.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-long shot from behind the figure, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A dark long-sleeved top with a red belt and dark pants with a light vertical stripe down the side, plus dark shoes.","hair_color":"White or very pale pink, glowing under the scene lighting.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair with a side part.","identity":"A 3D-rendered humanoid figure with a pale face, dark eyes, and a slim build, shown from behind and in profile.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza at night with a wet reflective floor, a domed glass building with glowing teal signage on the left, and a tall building with lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":["Exact hair color (white vs. pale pink) is ambiguous due to the colored lighting.","Facial features are mostly hidden because the figure is seen from behind and in profile."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a close rear view of the upper body to a wider full-body rear three-quarter shot. The character is centered in a futuristic plaza with a domed glass building on the left and a tall lit building on the right, matching the reference framing. The same arm-raise, head-touch, and hand-on-hip motion occurs in a similar sequence and timing.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle, using the reference image for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, clothing, action, scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Exact hair color remains ambiguous due to scene lighting.
Facial expression cannot be fully verified because the figure is mostly seen from behind and in profile.
unexpected_changes: The output frames include visible black letterbox bars at the top and bottom, changing the aspect presentation.
